title: Oriol Paulo Returns to Netflix With 'Proxies', Premiering on 11 December
summary: Eduard Fernández, Mario Casas, Blanca Suárez, Nicolás Francella and Alexandra Jiménez star in this new film
body_markdown:
Entertainment


14 October 2026


Global


Spain


Link copied to clipboard


####


Eduard Fernández, Mario Casas, Blanca Suárez, Nicolás Francella and Alexandra Jiménez star in the new film from the director of


The Innocent, God's Crooked Lines


and


The Invisible Guest


[Download the teaser poster](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/b8e93fad-d5f7-4de8-be9a-d687b1762dd5/3dd435f1-c6f9-11f1-9992-12ffd5e6b5db)


Netflix has today announced the release date and unveiled the teaser poster for


Proxies


, the new thriller from


Oriol Paulo


, one of the filmmakers who has helped redefine genre cinema in Spain over the past decade. The film will


premiere globally on Netflix on 11 December


.


Directed by


Oriol Paulo


and written by Paulo and


Guillem Clua


, the film brings together


Eduard Fernández


(


The 47,od's Crooked Lines


),


Mario Casas


(


The Dinner, The Innocent


),


Blanca Suárez


(


Hidden Murder, Breathless


),


Nicolás Francella


(


The House of the Spirits, High Seas


) and


Alexandra Jiménez


(


Go Team!, 53 Sundays


).


The film tells the story of how, on Christmas Eve morning, a man walks into a police station and confesses to killing two or three people. Yet, behind his confession lies a question that is harder to answer: why he has decided to turn himself in now, and what he hopes to achieve with his confession. From that point on, his story soon becomes linked to another seemingly closed case, one that defies all logic.


Produced by


Juanita Films


,


Proxies


was filmed at various locations in Catalonia.


Oriol Paulo


and


Miguel Ángel Faura


serve as executive producers, producing alongside


Libertad Ribera


and


Jaume Martí


.


Bernat Bosch


is the director of photography, and the original music is by


Fernando Velázquez.


About Juanita Films


Founded by screenwriter and director Oriol Paulo alongside Libertad Ribera, Juanita Films is a Barcelona based production company dedicated to developing and producing film and television projects. The company was established with the aim of championing original stories that possess a distinctive narrative identity and clear international appeal. Its first production is


Proxies


, an original Netflix thriller.
